This file runs our three analysis scripts and puts the results we used in the final paper in one place. The scripts still do all of their calculations, but this report only shows the six tables and five figures from the paper.

```{r master-setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
set.seed(415)

# Install any packages that aren't already on this computer.
# This should only install things the first time someone runs the project.
packages <- c(
  "rmarkdown", "knitr", "callr", "tidyverse", "here", "scales",
  "rpart", "randomForest", "glmnet", "xgboost"
)
missing_packages <- packages[!vapply(packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]

if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
  install.packages(missing_packages, dependencies = c("Depends", "Imports", "LinkingTo"))
}

# Check that the installations worked before running the analyses.
still_missing <- packages[!vapply(packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(still_missing) > 0) {
  stop("These packages could not be installed: ", paste(still_missing, collapse = ", "),
       ". Check your internet connection and try knitting again.")
}

# Start RStudio in the main project folder, where the code and data folders are.
project_root <- normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/", mustWork = TRUE)
script_names <- c("02 - Descriptive Analysis.Rmd", "03 - Hypothesis Tests and Regression.Rmd", "04 - Predictive Modeling.Rmd")
script_paths <- file.path(project_root, "code", script_names)
data_paths <- file.path(project_root, c(
  "data/processed/pre_covid_clean.csv",
  "data/processed/post_covid_clean.csv",
  "data/split/training_data.csv",
  "data/split/test_data.csv",
  "data/split/validation_data.csv"
))
missing_files <- c(script_paths, data_paths)[!file.exists(c(script_paths, data_paths))]
if (length(missing_files)) {
  stop("Required project files were not found. Open the project .Rproj file, put Run Project.Rmd in its root folder, and check:\n",
       paste(missing_files, collapse = "\n"))
}

# Keep the tables and figures for the paper together in their own folder.
paper_dir <- file.path(project_root, "outputs", "paper_only")
figure_dir <- file.path(paper_dir, "figures")
table_dir <- file.path(paper_dir, "tables")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Run copies of the three scripts so their original files stay untouched.
# Send any figures and tables they save to our paper-only output folder.
build_dir <- tempfile("paper_only_build_")
dir.create(build_dir, recursive = TRUE)
for (i in seq_along(script_paths)) {
  contents <- readLines(script_paths[i], warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  old <- 'final_paper_dir <- file.path(project_root, "outputs", "final_paper")'
  new <- 'final_paper_dir <- file.path(project_root, "outputs", "paper_only")'
  if (!any(grepl(old, contents, fixed = TRUE))) {
    stop("Could not find the expected export directory in: ", script_names[i])
  }
  contents <- gsub(old, new, contents, fixed = TRUE)
  temp_input <- file.path(build_dir, script_names[i])
  writeLines(contents, temp_input, useBytes = TRUE)
  # Each script needs its own R session. Running render() directly in this
  # setup chunk makes knitr reuse chunk labels like "setup" and stops the report.
  message("Running: ", script_names[i])
  callr::r(
    function(input, output_file, output_dir, project_root) {
      rmarkdown::render(
        input = input,
        output_format = "html_document",
        output_file = output_file,
        output_dir = output_dir,
        knit_root_dir = project_root,
        envir = new.env(parent = globalenv()),
        quiet = TRUE
      )
    },
    args = list(
      input = temp_input,
      output_file = sprintf("internal_analysis_%02d.html", i),
      output_dir = build_dir,
      project_root = project_root
    ),
    show = FALSE
  )
}

# The scripts generate more results than we need to show.
# Pull out the tables that actually appear in our paper.
read_table <- function(filename) {
  path <- file.path(table_dir, paste0(filename, ".csv"))
  if (!file.exists(path)) stop("An expected source table was not created: ", path,
                               "\nCheck the original source script's knit log and required input data.")
  utils::read.csv(path, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}
write_table <- function(x, stem) {
  utils::write.csv(x, file.path(table_dir, paste0(stem, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
}
format_p <- function(p) ifelse(is.na(p), "NA", ifelse(p < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p)))

# Table I: descriptive statistics from Script 02, including standard errors.
desc <- read_table("table_01_descriptive_means_and_ci")
table_1 <- data.frame(
  Period = desc$`Survey Period`,
  Outcome = ifelse(desc$Outcome == "Anxiety", "GAD", "PHQ"),
  N = desc$N,
  Mean = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(desc$Mean)),
  SD = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(desc$SD)),
  SE = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(desc$SD) / sqrt(as.numeric(desc$N))),
  `95% CI` = vapply(strsplit(gsub("[()]", "", desc$`95% CI`), ","), function(z) {
    sprintf("(%.3f, %.3f)", as.numeric(trimws(z[1])), as.numeric(trimws(z[2])))
  }, character(1)),
  check.names = FALSE
)
table_1 <- table_1[order(table_1$Period, table_1$Outcome), , drop = FALSE]

# Table II: adjusted regression results from Script 03.
reg <- read_table("table_02_adjusted_phq_gad_regression_ci")
pretty_term <- function(x) {
  if (x == "(Intercept)") return("Intercept")
  if (grepl("^Period", x)) return("Period: 2022–2023")
  if (grepl("^gender", x)) return("Gender: Women")
  if (grepl("^field", x)) return("Field: STEM")
  if (grepl("^race\\.2", x)) return(paste0("Race: ", sub("^race\\.2", "", x)))
  if (grepl("^yr_sch\\.2", x)) {
    y <- sub("^yr_sch\\.2", "", x)
    return(paste0("Year: ", switch(y, secondyear="Second year", thirdyear="Third year", "fourthyear+"="Fourth year +", y)))
  }
  if (x == "fincur.2") return("Financial status")
  if (x == "age") return("Age")
  x
}
table_2 <- data.frame(
  Outcome = reg$Outcome,
  Predictor = vapply(reg$Predictor, pretty_term, character(1)),
  Coefficient = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(reg$Coefficient)),
  SE = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(reg$Standard_Error)),
  `95% CI` = sprintf("(%.3f, %.3f)", as.numeric(reg$CI_Lower), as.numeric(reg$CI_Upper)),
  t = sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(reg$T_Value)),
  p = format_p(as.numeric(reg$P_Value)), check.names = FALSE
)

# Table III: interactions with survey period from Script 03.
inter <- read_table("table_03_period_interaction_results")
table_3 <- data.frame(
  Outcome = inter$Outcome,
  Interaction = inter$Interaction,
  Coefficient = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(inter$Coefficient)),
  SE = sprintf("%.3f", as.numeric(inter$Standard_Error)),
  `95% CI` = sprintf("(%.3f, %.3f)", as.numeric(inter$CI_Lower), as.numeric(inter$CI_Upper)),
  t = sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(inter$T_Value)),
  p = format_p(as.numeric(inter$P_Value)), check.names = FALSE
)

# Tables IV–VI: testing, predictor comparisons, and validation from Script 04.
table_4 <- read_table("table_04_all_eight_models_test_metrics")
table_5 <- read_table("table_05_full_vs_reduced_models")
table_6 <- read_table("table_06_validation_model_metrics")
for (i in 4:6) {
  tt <- get(paste0("table_", i))
  names(tt)[names(tt) == "R²"] <- "R²"
  assign(paste0("table_", i), tt)
}

names_of_tables <- c(
  "table_01_descriptive_statistics", "table_02_adjusted_regression",
  "table_03_period_interactions", "table_04_testing_models",
  "table_05_predictor_sets", "table_06_validation_models"
)
for (i in 1:6) write_table(get(paste0("table_", i)), names_of_tables[i])

# Figure 1: compare average PHQ and GAD scores in the two survey periods.
figure_1_data <- desc
figure_1_data$Outcome <- factor(figure_1_data$Outcome,
                               levels = c("Anxiety", "Depression"),
                               labels = c("Anxiety (GAD-7)", "Depression (PHQ-9)"))
figure_1_data$`Survey Period` <- factor(figure_1_data$`Survey Period`,
                                      levels = c("2017-2018", "2022-2023"))
figure_1 <- ggplot2::ggplot(figure_1_data,
                           ggplot2::aes(x = Outcome, y = Mean, fill = `Survey Period`)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(position = ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.78), width = 0.66) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c("2017-2018" = "#377EB8", "2022-2023" = "#E69F00")) +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Average Depression and Anxiety", x = NULL,
                y = "Mean item score (1–4)", fill = "Survey period") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
                 legend.position = "bottom")
figure_files <- c(
  "figure_01_average_scores.png",
  "figure_02_gender_stem_interactions.png",
  "figure_03_validation_observed_vs_predicted.png",
  "figure_04_validation_residuals.png",
  "figure_05_validation_confusion_matrices.png"
)
ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, figure_files[1]), plot = figure_1,
                width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
source_figures <- c(
  "figure_02_gender_stem_interactions.png",
  "figure_05_validation_observed_vs_predicted.png",
  "figure_06_validation_residuals.png",
  "figure_07_best_validation_confusion_matrices.png"
)
for (i in seq_along(source_figures)) {
  src <- file.path(figure_dir, source_figures[i]); dst <- file.path(figure_dir, figure_files[i + 1])
  if (!file.exists(src)) stop("Missing required paper figure: ", src)
  if (normalizePath(src, mustWork = FALSE) != normalizePath(dst, mustWork = FALSE)) {
    if (!file.copy(src, dst, overwrite = TRUE)) stop("Unable to copy paper figure: ", src)
  }
}

# Remove extra exports so this folder only has what is in the paper.
for (p in list.files(table_dir, full.names = TRUE)) {
  if (!basename(p) %in% paste0(names_of_tables, ".csv")) unlink(p)
}
for (p in list.files(figure_dir, full.names = TRUE)) {
  if (!basename(p) %in% figure_files) unlink(p)
}

# We do not need to keep the temporary reports from each script.
unlink(build_dir, recursive = TRUE, force = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```
